concept: A room-sized locomotive emerges continuously through a tiny handheld matchbox

pixel_criteria.criterion: Describe the whole image first without intensity labels; the impossible miniature-to-room scale relationship must dominate its first impression.

One locomotive and the same two rails are visibly continuous from miniature inside the box across its lip to the large front engine; disconnected toy and large train or ordinary forced perspective fail.
Both hands support/open the small box; cardboard lip visibly occludes the small train segment at the passage boundary; whole relation is visible together. Partial evidence fails.
Face, dark short bob and fine wispy bangs visibly follow the portrait without identity, age or personality inference.
